release_notes: Build 147 makes the 14-quiz Autopilot target behave as a continuous minimum while the app is open.
Schedule inventory is checked every minute with a five-second startup check, and the duplicate-start guard is reduced from 20 minutes to two minutes.
Removes the retired AutopilotRecovery YouTube state as a schedule-production gate so stale Recovering or Needs setup state cannot block top-ups indefinitely.
Autopilot now shows when it is waiting for current production or a short retry guard instead of only saying quizzes are queued.
